rules.matchersWeakenedNote: No matcher is loosened. The parser comparison (rules.selfCheck) lists every build read not present verbatim at HEAD (91; the 34 base reads are the same e2e reads, base = build there). Each is (a) the same read on Round 7’s subject or locator (`.clr-equipment-summary` for `[data-equipment-summary]`, `.clr-equipment-summary__empty` for `data-equipment-none`, the label’s own svg, `.clr-movement-identity`, the name element as the column, `nameOf()` for `[data-movement-name]`, `rowsOf()`/`rows()` for Review’s standard block, list-item words for data attributes, per-line-box contrast), (b) a Round 7 look or wording rewrite under the owner’s rule (rules.retiredAssertions, rules.forTask115), or (c) a read of a gallery variant or scene Round 7’s accepted state does not draw, proved on the real routes instead. Two no-paragraph reads became exact (`toEqual([label])`, `toEqual([label, none])`). No getBy became queryBy, no `not` read was removed (`not.toContainElement` became `toContainElement` with the name-words `not.toContainElement` kept), no count was dropped, no exact text became a regex. Three reads were restored after the comparison (`words.nextElementSibling` is the equipment, the metric grid’s class, the two shipped glyphs’ count).
